description: New York ISO real-time zonal electricity prices from NYISO's public MIS files: the latest 5-minute LBMP ($/MWh) for each of the 15 zones and interfaces (CAPITL, N.Y.C., LONGIL, WEST...) with its loss and congestion components, plus the day's average so far per zone. Eastern time stamps; real-time market only (day-ahead not included). Choose this tool for: New York ISO real-time zonal electricity prices. Close alternatives on this server: energy_miso_midcontinent_iso (MISO real-time generation fuel mix: MW and share for coal); energy_caiso_california_iso (CAISO grid today, from its Today's Outlook data: latest). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
